definitions.source_order: Columns 1..8 in the same modal order; all source columns from one built model per run
definitions.complex_encoding: [real, imag]; rows are observation channels and columns are independent sources
definitions.A: Raw outgoing amplitude per nominal 1 W/m source after declared analytic phase/reference-plane correction; used unchanged as approximate unit-input response within ||B-I||2 <= 0.005. No A B^-1 correction or fitted phases.
definitions.B: Raw bidirectional analytic incoming modal amplitudes in the same basis; normalization checked by operator norm ||B-I||2.
definitions.eta_all: sigma_min(T)^2: minimum target-output power over every normalized complex logical input
definitions.F6: min over |0>,|1>,|+>,|->,|+i>,|-i> of |(U psi)^dagger T psi|^2 / ||T psi||^2
definitions.conditional_choi_overlap: |Tr(U^dagger T)|^2 / (2 Tr(T^dagger T)); not measured process tomography
definitions.split_ratios: |T[0,j]|^2/|T[1,j]|^2 for each logical basis input j
definitions.passivity: sigma_max(A) <= 1.005 for the full observed 8x8 matrix
definitions.reciprocity: max absolute entry of A-A^T <= 0.005 in the fixed common basis
definitions.signed_flux: Eight independent source-free interior surface sums (four signed physical-port fluxes plus open outward flux), normalized to declared 1 W/m; absolute closure <= 0.005. Modal-versus-net-flux differences remain unresolved.
definitions.convergence: Absolute changes in all six throughputs and eta_all <=0.005; F6 and Choi <=0.002; both ratios <=0.02. Exact fixed recipe defines all 13 pairs.
definitions.gauge: Real analytic TM0 positive at guide center and TM1 positive on positive transverse side; Thetap=0; known reference-plane phase lengths only, no fitted per-port phase.

limitations: 2D material-index surrogate; seven discrete wavelengths (five training and two holdout); mesh/domain-boundary checks at four selected training wavelengths and stronger-PML/projection checks at two selected training wavelengths; no continuous-band proof or paper measured-fidelity equivalence
2D bulk-permittivity surrogate eps_core=12.1, eps_clad=2.1; not a calibrated 220 nm SOI effective-index or full 3D device.
No fabricated efficiency, measured quantum process fidelity, continuous-band guarantee, fabrication tolerance, or universal mode/continuum completeness claim.

Original native receipt/artifact hashes are provenance links only. Compact data cannot reverify omitted MPH, full console, fields or compiled classes. Fresh licensed COMSOL execution is required for full reproduction.
